name: Microwave Ragi Halwa (No Added Sugar)
steps: Mix the ragi flour and besan with the soy milk in a large bowl until no lumps remain.
Add the banana, cardamom, oil and salt.
Microwave on high for 2 minutes, stir well, then microwave for 2 more minutes in 1-minute bursts, stirring each time, until thick and glossy.
note: Sweetened only by banana. Ragi is rich in calcium; keep the portion modest if you are watching carbohydrates.
